breakpoints.applies: no min-width — base rules are unprefixed. The one name carrying an `xs` segment is `.at-col-xs-2m3`, which is also unprefixed (see the `fifths` key)

legend.2m3: fifths column, 1 of 5 (misleading token name; the shipped width is 20%, not 2.5 of 3)
legend.active: active (full-word class token; see also act)
legend.blend: blend (legacy var token; active token is blnd)
legend.heading: heading
legend.spc: spacing (class token; legacy var --at-wrd-spg uses spg)
